svg.title: Whose clock wins? One outage, two records
svg.desc: gpu-003 on 3 October 2026: the provider recorded 04:12 to 06:40, the tenant 04:13 to 06:41. Counting only what both saw gives 04:13 to 06:40, 8,820 seconds; counting from the provider's first fault to the tenant's recovery gives 04:12 to 06:41, 8,940 seconds.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gpu-003, 3 October 2026. The contract's reconcile rules decide which record starts and ends the outage.
